summary: v73.0 BUG FIX VERIFIED - GERAR KIT button now works correctly when using grid of extracted items. Complete flow tested: Upload PDF → Type keyword 'canabidiol' → EXTRAIR ITENS → 3 items extracted → Fill value in grid → GERAR KIT → Success screen with download button.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX VERIFIED: processarDAMASimplificado (line 525-667) now has conditional validation at lines 534-548
VALIDATION LOGIC: if damaItensGrid.length === 0 → check manual entry (damaItemNumero/damaItemValorRaw); else → check grid items (selecionado && valorRaw)
handleValorChange (line 699-746) correctly updates valorRaw in grid items when user types values
GERAR KIT button disabled condition (line 1866-1872) correctly checks both grid and manual entry scenarios
Status indicator (line 1883-1890) shows '✅ X item(ns) pronto(s) para gerar' when items have values

context_for_next_testing_agent: v73.0 bug fix verified. HC IMPORTAÇÕES has timbrado 'modelo hc Dama.docx'. EXTRAIR ITENS extracts items by keyword using Gemini AI. Grid items need valorRaw filled to enable GERAR KIT button.

BUG_FIX_GERAR_KIT_WITH_GRID.details: GERAR KIT button works when using grid of extracted items (not just manual entry). Tested complete flow: Upload PDF → keyword 'canabidiol' → EXTRAIR ITENS → 3 items found → Fill value 1500 → GERAR KIT → Success screen

GRID_VALOR_UPDATE.details: After extraction, filling value in grid item correctly updates valorRaw. Input shows green border when value is filled.

VALIDATION_NO_VALUES.details: GERAR KIT button is disabled when no items have values filled. Shows warning '💡 Preencha o valor dos itens que deseja participar'

VALIDATION_WITH_VALUES.details: GERAR KIT button becomes enabled when at least one selected item has value. Shows status '✅ 1 item(ns) pronto(s) para gerar'

COMPLETE_FLOW.details: Full flow verified: Upload PDF → Type keyword → EXTRAIR ITENS → Fill value → GERAR KIT → Success screen with download button showing 'KIT LICITAÇÃO PRONTO!'

GERAR KIT Button State - With Values

bug_fix_details.original_issue: Após extrair itens por palavra-chave e preencher valores no grid, clicar em GERAR KIT não faz nada
bug_fix_details.root_cause: processarDAMASimplificado tinha validação incorreta que verificava damaItemNumero/damaItemValor mesmo quando usava grid de itens
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Validação condicional: if damaItensGrid.length === 0 → verifica entrada manual; senão → verifica itens selecionados com valorRaw no grid
bug_fix_details.verification: Complete flow tested successfully - GERAR KIT button enabled and kit generated with success screen
